<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## What's Changed
* Ignore Ubuntu release list link check failures by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24196
* Require test resources in homebrew/core by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24180
* Preserve cask approval for copied helpers by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24191
* Add OSS Scanner Dockerfile and threat model by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24199
* spdx: store downcased licenses in hash across calls by @alebcay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24197
* Harden tap redirect trust and rollback by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24198
* Fix offline, vacuous and repo-leaking specs by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24200
* Ignore hidden directories when listing taps by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24201
* Isolate Bootsnap caches across gem changes by @SSakutaro in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24206
* Bump portable-ruby to 4.0.7_1 by @brew-commit-app[bot] in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24211
* Check untrusted conflicts without loading them by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24208
* Avoid duplicate source upgrades of dependencies by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24209
* Report net dependency impact in test-bot by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24213
* Avoid nested formula locks while linking by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24207
* formula_versions: allow test-only resources by @daeho-ro in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24218
* Show versions of dependencies in dry-run by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24210
* Extend `T::Generic` in Tapioca DSL compilers by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24219
* rubocop: Always run the "every formula should have a test block" check by @issyl0 in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24188
* Suppress developer mode warnings in CI by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24220
* bundle: protect Brewfile formulae during cleanup by @AbdelrahmanHafez in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24222
* advisory-match: emit split affected intervals by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24223
* advisory-match: add --rejected-candidates by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24224
* advisory-match: reuse platform-independent history by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24225
* cask/audit: check signing of more artifact types by @bevanjkay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24227
* Check cask receipt tap when untapping by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24228
* pr-publish: reset label inputs per pull request by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24232
* pr-publish: remove large runner uploads by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24233
* advisory-match: fix spec indentation warning by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24234
* advisory-match: cache historical formula source by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24231
* Fix local formula sources in brew info by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24238
* Add cop for ternaries with nil branches by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24239
* Read protected install step symlinks with sudo by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24241
* sort search results by version by @adamv in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24240
* utils/pypi: preserve `:test` resources by @botantony in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24242
* bundle: protect alternate formula names by @AbdelrahmanHafez in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24229
* Document yearly `BottleTransition` update by @hyuraku in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24243
* cask/audit: skip resource-only bundles by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24247
* test: isolate tty? and command lookup fixtures by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24245
* cask/ci/check: ignore more running Apple apps by @bevanjkay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24244
* bundle: upgrade outdated npm packages by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24254
* docs: unify formula and cask description guidelines by @bevanjkay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24256
* info: show build deps for source installs by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24258
* Exclude end date from approved-review searches by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24260
* Keep ENV build metadata off the shareable ENV by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24249
* Require lead maintainer review for CODEOWNERS by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24265
* Accept dependency tag arrays in API metadata by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24262
* Stop bundle specs leaking Tap and Cask doubles by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24267
* Preserve and validate no_linkage metadata by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24263
* Use full names for tap migration targets by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24266
* utils/curl: guess charset from a `<meta>` tag by @hyuraku in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24257
* info: show revision in headline upgrade version by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24271
* curl: stop retrying local download write failures by @BrandenXia in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24275
* audit: flag self-submissions by commit email by @bevanjkay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24277
* shared_audits: parse whois dates with spaces by @bevanjkay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24276
* cask: merge uninstall and zap directives into one pass by @bevanjkay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24194
* Disclaim sandbox TCC responsibility when available by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24272
* audit: require livecheck for new packages by @bevanjkay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24279
* Make source build dependency upgrades more liberal by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24273
* rubocops/cask: disallow bare ToDesktop wildcard by @krehel in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24281
* api: revalidate JSON API caches with ETag, not the bumped mtime by @xrl in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24193
* Truncate summary versions to fit terminal width by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24283
* Add vulnerability-aware package management by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24274
* unpack: explain extraction disk space failures by @BrandenXia in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24278
* Tighten bottle attestation verification by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24282
* Preserve build errors with Pathname arguments by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24292
* Serialise Pathnames in forked child errors by @dduugg in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24294
* Publish local patch checksums in the formula API by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24284
* Preserve cask backups across lifecycle phases by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24295

## New Contributors
* @BrandenXia made their first contribution in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24275
* @xrl made their first contribution in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24193

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/compare/7.0.9...7.0.10
